answer: The voyage counter is kept in raven and nebula shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 791 identities would post 3799 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
